title: Surface area of cuboids and cubes
goal: I can calculate the surface area of cuboids and cubes.
teach: The surface area is the total area of all the faces (the area of the net). A cuboid has 3 pairs of equal rectangles: SA = 2(lb + lh + bh). A cube has 6 equal squares: SA = 6s². Surface area is in square units (cm²).
tvis: SA = 2(5 × 3 + 5 × 4 + 3 × 4) = 2(15 + 20 + 12) = 94 cm²

ex.q: An open box (no lid) is 10 cm by 6 cm by 4 cm. Find its outside surface area.

watch:
Surface area is in cm²; volume is in cm³. Do not mix them up.

Problem-solving lens
Pair the faces: front and back, top and bottom, left and right. Find one of each, add, then double.

qs.text: Find the surface area of a 5 cm by 4 cm by 3 cm cuboid.
qs.steps:
1. Formula: surface area of a cuboid SA = 2 × (l × b + l × h + b × h), the total area of its 6 faces.
2. SA = 2 × (5 × 4 + 5 × 3 + 4 × 3)
3. = 2 × (20 + 15 + 12) = 2 × 47 = 94 cm²

qs.text: Find the surface area of a cube with sides of 10 cm.
qs.steps:
1. Formula: surface area of a cube SA = 6 × s², because it has 6 equal square faces.
2. SA = 6 × 10²
3. = 6 × 100 = 600 cm²

qs.text: Find the surface area of a 10 cm by 6 cm by 4 cm cuboid.
qs.steps:
1. Formula: surface area of a cuboid SA = 2 × (l × b + l × h + b × h), the total area of its 6 faces.
2. SA = 2 × (10 × 6 + 10 × 4 + 6 × 4)
3. = 2 × (60 + 40 + 24) = 2 × 124 = 248 cm²
